# Thanksgiving Hymns Column 23 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 1QHa (Cave 1), Col. 23 | **Condition:** fragmentary

---

**23:1** [...] I thank You, O Lord, for You have saved my soul from the-pit,

**23:2** [...] and from Sheol-of Abaddon You have raised me up to an eternal height,

**23:3** [...] and I walk upon a boundless plain, and I know that there is hope

**23:4** [...] for him whom You have formed from the-dust for the-eternal council.

**23:5** And a perverted spirit You have cleansed from great transgression,

**23:6** to take-his-stand in the-assembly with the-host-of the-holy-ones,

**23:7** and to enter into community with the-congregation-of the-sons-of heaven.

**23:8** And You have cast for a man an eternal lot with the-spirits-of knowledge,

**23:9** to praise Your name in the-community-of jubilation and to recount Your wonders before all Your works.

**23:10** [...] And I, a creature-of clay, what am I? Kneaded with water, for what am I reckoned?

**23:11** [...] and You have raised me up, and You have set [...] and I know [...]

**23:12** [...] that there is righteousness in Your truth, and [...] in Your lovingkindness [...]

**23:13** [...] and I have leaned upon Your mercies, and [...] for You have not [...]

**23:14** [...] let me perish in my guilt, for You support me [...]

**23:15** [...] and You have given me understanding in Your truth, and in Your mysteries [...]

**23:16** [...] You have made-known to me, and in Your wonderful-secret [...] You have [...]

**23:17** [...] before You my steps are established, and [...] against the-wicked [...]

**23:18** [...] and You have strengthened my heart in Your covenant, and my feet [...]

**23:19** [...] stand upon the-rock, and [...] the-ways-of eternity [...]

**23:20** [...] there is hope for him whom You have turned from transgression, and [...]

**23:21** [...] You have not abandoned my soul in [...] and You have sustained [...]

**23:22** [...] my life from destruction, and [...] in the-midst-of lions [...]

**23:23** [...] appointed for the-sons-of guilt, lions that crush the-bones [...]

**23:24** [...] of the-mighty, and they drink the-blood-of [...] warriors [...]

**23:25** [...] and You have set me as a banner for the-chosen-of righteousness,

**23:26** [...] and as a knowing interpreter-of wonderful-mysteries, to test [...]

**23:27** [...] the-men-of truth, and to try those-who-love correction [...]

**23:28** [...] but against the-interpreters-of error I am an adversary [...]

**23:29** [...] and a man-of peace to all those-who-see truth [...]

**23:30** [...] Your name is [...] forever, and [...] for eternity [...]

**23:31** [...] and in Your glory my light has shone-forth, for a light [...]

**23:32** [...] from darkness You have caused to shine, and [...] for healing [...]

**23:33** [...] and wonderful strength to him-who-is [...] and a sign for eternity [...]

**23:34** [...] forever [...]

---

*EMET notes: Column 23 preserves the opening of a thanksgiving hymn with the classic hodayah formula "I thank You, O Lord." The self-abasement motif ("creature of clay") contrasts with the exaltation to angelic fellowship. "Lions" imagery in 23:22-24 parallels similar martial metaphors in the Hodayot. Construct chains hyphenated throughout.*
